findings.title: DPO rows are machine-targeted and blocked from common training
findings.evidence: All 12 local DPO rows include target_machine, privacy classification, source/license and redaction gates, common_training_allowed=false, user_local_store_required=true, and no_training_executed=true.

findings.title: Local/common separation is represented and common promotion is quarantined
findings.evidence: The source/license/redaction review keeps all rows user-local or quarantined for common use and requires license/redaction/universalization/source-disjoint/target/rollback approval before any common use.

findings.title: Backup/export/import/share portability probe is missing
findings.evidence: The active plan expects backup-export-import-share-report.md/json and requires the backup/export/import/share path to be proven. The user-local store manifest and plan define export packets, import requirements, share redaction, load order, and backup rules, but no executed backup/export/import/share portability probe or backup-export-import-share-report.md/json was found in the reviewed lifecycle reports.

findings.title: PromptToTask and SkillSelection lifecycle evidence remains overlay-scoped
findings.evidence: Fresh-load, held-out/ablation, and rollback reports all preserve PARTIAL_ADAPTIVE_LOADER_ONLY or PARTIAL_OVERLAY wording for PromptToTask and SkillSelection.

findings.title: Common model readiness is not claimed
findings.evidence: State and review passes 11-13 preserve no common readiness, no promotion readiness, no semantic quality, and no learnability claims.

patch_decision.reason: No existing state or lifecycle/DPO wording was patched in this repair, but the review verdict was downgraded because the active plan requires executed backup/export/import/share proof and the expected report artifacts are missing.

required_next_action: Run a bounded backup/export/import/share portability probe and produce backup-export-import-share-report.md/json before final review can continue.
final_verdict_rationale: PASS_WITH_BLOCKING_GAP: DPO rows are machine-targeted and gated for user-local storage; local/common separation and source/license/redaction review block common use; local lifecycle evidence covers storage, backup-before-mutation, staged targets, continue-training, fresh-load, held-out/ablation, and rollback. However, the active plan expects backup-export-import-share-report.md/json and requires the backup/export/import/share path to be proven. Only the portability contract is documented; no executed portability probe was found, so final review cannot continue until that bounded probe is run. Common model readiness is not claimed.
